CORRIGENDUM

Subject: Corrigendum to the Project Guidelines of the Centrally Sponsored Project for
Computerization of Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS) - reg.

The project guidelines for the Centrally Sponsored Project for Computerization of
Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) were issued to all the States/UTs vide this
Ministry's letter dated 02.01.2023. Subsequently, during the 3 meeting of the National Level
Monitoring and Implementation Committee (NLMIC) held on 06.06.2023 under the chairmanship
of Secretary (M/o Cooperation). As decided in the meeting the following revisions modification
are hereby made to the project guidelines:

Point (a) under 3.7.1 i) “Members of National Level Monitoring and Implementation
Committee (NLMIC)” may be read as:

Under 3.11 “Data Management” may be read as:

“The data shall be housed at the National Level Data Repository (NLDR). Data generated at
PACS would be routed, either through the DCCBs or State Data Centers, to the National
Level Data Repository (NLDR). All data will be shared with/ deposited and maintained at
NLDR, in conformity with the rules and regulations. Given availability of connectivity, all data
will be available at NLDR level as at the end of the previous day.

The data will be maintained at NLDR and will be available for use by Central Government,
State Government and other authorized stakeholders. The data will be utilized to generate
various national/ state/ district level reports for Government of India, State Governments,
NABARD, StCB, DCCB and other stakeholders, for the purpose of information based
effective policy making.

Till the time of establishment of full-fledged NLDR, NABARD may procure temporary data
storage solution as Stop-gap arrangement as per procurement guidelines with due approval
of competent authority.”

The para number and first point under 3.11 “Selection of PACS”, may be read as:
“3.12 Selection of PACS

e All functional PACS will be eligible for joining the project. A PACS will be deemed
functional if it fulfils the necessary condition i.e., completion of Audit of accounts of
PACS for the financial year 2021-22. If the selection is being done in FY 2023-24 or
FY 2024-25, then audit of the respective previous year will be the cut-off date for
audit. However, in case selection has been done in 2022-23 but computerisation is
being done in 2023-24, cut-off date for digitisation of legacy data will be taken as
318t March 2023.”

Point (b) under 6 “Legal framework” may be read as under:

“A tripartite Service Level Agreement (SLA) will also be executed between State Government,
StCB/DCCB and the System Integrator (SI).”
